dialogues.speaker: Dmitriev
dialogues.text: Soon... If he comes, I'm saved.

dialogues.speaker: Dmitriev
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm waiting for Estragon. He said he'd come by to pick up the goods, but he hasn't shown up yet... I've lost track of how late he is.

dialogues.speaker: Dmitriev
dialogues.text: If he doesn't come, I'll just have to wait here. There's nothing else I can do.

dialogues.speaker: Dmitriev
dialogues.text: Goodbye... Just a little longer... He's coming... He's on his way.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is he the buyer for your goods?

dialogues.speaker: Dmitriev
dialogues.text: Yes. We agreed to meet here. But he still hasn't shown up. I don't dare leave the goods behind to look for him, so all I can do is wait.

dialogues.speaker: Dmitriev
dialogues.text: I've been waiting here day after day... If he shows up, I'll finally be saved.

dialogues.speaker: Dmitriev
dialogues.text: I'm about to hang myself while waiting.
